negatives.name: missing-hidden-page
negatives.reason: Hidden slide omitted or unexpected page count

scope: Named authored zero/max/index-disambiguation and mixed implicit allocation controls: exact source/native prompt/local identities, owners, frames, content, image and notes/hidden relationships. Native idx omission is accepted only as schema-default zero. Preserve/unselected used glyph programs/positions and picture probes stay exact; only the expected master accent changes on preserve. All PDF records and package parts remain exact through three native reopen rounds except validated clock/TotalTime values. First-save differences outside the named graph are recorded, not universally declared source-equivalent. No full native-template import, general reset, cross-document identity mapping or source write authority.
